property_summary: For any call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether from a contract whose receive/fallback always succeeds, if the call is made at a block number that is a multiple of 15 then the reference C will drain its balance (address(c).balance == 0) after the call; the mutant flips the conditional and will NOT drain on those multiples of 15, so there exists inputs (a caller contract and block number multiple of 15) that make the mutant diverge.
change_summary: Change the conditional that pays out to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0, altering when balance is transferred and thus observable state.
